dependencies.title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Cables - Part 1: Up to 1100 V; Code of Practice for Installation of Power Cables [IS 1255]
dependencies.evidence: Partial Match: Proposed standard covers the physical cable, but the tender explicitly mandates Providing and Laying underground cable, which requires laying code IS 1255.

dependencies.title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Cables - Part 1: Up to 1100 V; Code of Practice for Earthing [IS 3043]
dependencies.evidence: Partial Match: Proposed standard covers generator earthing, but the tender specifically dictates Cable connection, which requires LT power cable standard IS 7098 Part 1.
